visual_review.identity: Dusty ochre/gray-brown bare rock soil with scattered gray-brown angular stones, almost no vegetation and broad pale eroded bands. Original non-paved bare scree identity retained.
visual_review.density_caveat: More than 25 visible stone groups and individual stones, above proposed 12-18. Quiet overall contrast but residual fine soil facets and scattered small marks remain.
visual_review.composition_caveat: A few connected pale erosion bands create branching streaks across the surface. These are baked material coloration, not new traversable paths or geometry; catalog/scene review should assess their repeated visibility.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Main stones commonly read roughly 8-18 world units wide at the proposed 256 period, above guidance. Palette is warmer/lighter ochre than the original muted dusty earth.
visual_review.native_acceptance: 1254 fully opaque native, current tone 2 source candidate for 30 non-authored mountain cells. No scene binding or natural seamlessness claim.
